thread:
aly: Quick sync  PR #1101 adds a short troubleshooting note for 429s/timeouts but a couple SDK snippets use pre-0.9.1 names. Can someone sweep?
ben: Which lines? I can update samples and add a tiny migration blurb.
aly: The JS snippet uses `client.opts({max_inflight: 16})` and the Python example still references `retry_flag=True`. In SDK 0.9.1 we renamed `max_inflight` -> `inflight_limit` and the runtime manages retry behavior via fallback policies, so drop the explicit flag.
cara: I'll prepare a micro-PR to change samples and add a short "What changed (0.9.0 -> 0.9.1)" callout. Also propose a mini checklist we call "playbook-lite" for users: 1) lower inflight_limit, 2) enable prefix/KV cache, 3) add exp backoff + jitter.
ben: Suggest adding a tiny staging repro command to help Support: `siege -c50 -r20 https://staging.api.redwood/v1/generate` and note to run from the same region/AZ.
aly: Good. Can we also add an example that runs the snippet against a local mock (examples/mock-backpressure) and wire it into docs CI so the sample fails if the API drifts?
cara: Yes; I'll add a one-file mock harness and a single mocha/jest test. I'll include the migration table mapping old->new names and a one-paragraph rationale about batching tradeoffs (cost vs p99).
doc-bot: playbook-lite checklist appended to PR #1101  items: samples-lint, examples-run, migration-callout, staging-repro-note
ben: Timeline: I'll land the snippet rename today. Cara will add the mock example + CI by tomorrow EOD. We'll add a 5-min slot in tomorrow's docs sync to sign off.
aly: After merge, please open a backport issue for the older troubleshooting doc so customers on SDK 0.8/0.9 see the migration note. doc-bot: backport queued post-merge. :white_check_mark:
